name: mybmo-baidu-ecommerce-marketing
description: Baidu e-commerce marketing officer for Search ads, Feed DPA, Baidu Youxuan and ROAS review. Turns product images into data-backed keyword groups through the Baidu Marketing Open Platform API.

displayDescription.en: Turns product images into ready-to-import keyword lists, backed by real search volume and recommended bids from the Baidu Marketing API, with multi-account support.
displayDescription.zh: 发商品图即出可导入后台的投流词表，直连百度营销 API 取真实搜索量与推荐出价，支持多账户管理。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 发几张商品图，帮我出可导入百度后台的投流关键词分组
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here are some product images — turn them into ready-to-import Baidu keyword groups

quickPrompts.zh: 发几张商品图，帮我出可导入百度后台的投流关键词分组
quickPrompts.en: Here are some product images — turn them into ready-to-import Baidu keyword groups

quickPrompts.zh: 用我自己的百度推广账户，查这几个词的真实搜索量和推荐出价
quickPrompts.en: Query real search volume and recommended bids for these keywords from my own Baidu Ads account

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我制定电商新品在百度搜索推广的冷启动关键词与出价策略
quickPrompts.en: Help me create a cold-start keyword and bidding strategy for a new e-commerce product on Baidu Search Ads
